caption: The drawing features two ornate brooch designs, centrally placed within a rectangular border on a beige background. The brooch on the left is predominantly gold and features a symmetrical shape with intricate detailing, a central square purple gemstone, and three teardrop-shaped purple gemstones hanging from its lower edge. The brooch on the right is also primarily gold with orange accents and has an elaborate, symmetrical pattern centered around an oval purple gemstone. Both brooches include small white pearl-like details as part of their design. The bottom of the page contains handwritten text: "Westchester County" on the left and "Drawn by Wm P. Sherwood" on the right.
title: Brooch
